extra_quotes: Magnetic properties were measured using a magnetic property measurement system (MPMS, Quantum Design).
Magnetization measurements under pressure were performed using a low-background pressure cell consisting of a CuBe cylinder, a zirconia piston, and a Teflon tube.
Electronic structure calculations for Fe 3GaTe2 were carried out within the framework of density functional theory (DFT) using the QUANTUM ESPRESSO package [44, 45].
